eligibility.usage_note: Card page section 'Available for EEA countries' names 29 countries (ISO mapping ours): 27 EEA states plus Ukraine, and also Austria and Hungary — but the Terms of Use (17 Sep 2026) prohibit the service for residents of Austria and Hungary (general prohibited-countries list, 56 territories incl. UK, US, Singapore, Japan). Contradiction recorded; AT and HU modelled as excluded (least favourable). Ireland and Sweden are not on the card page list. Limits 'up to €30,000' per month.

kyc.stages_note: Card page step 02: 'Upload your identity documents and pass liveness check'; FAQ 'Is KYC required?' — 'Yes. Pass a quick and smooth verification — powered by AI.' editorial.summary: Virtual Visa card from the Utorg on-ramp, marketed as non-custodial and funded with USDC on five networks; offered to residents of 27 listed EEA countries and Ukraine, with a €30,000 monthly limit. Zero payment and FX fees are advertised 'for a limited time' with no end date; the conversion margin, top-up cost and ATM access are not published. Identity verification (ID + liveness) is required before the card is issued. The card issuer is not disclosed: the service is provided by Chain Valley Sp. z o.o. with Wirex Pay.
good_for: USDC holders in the listed EEA countries or Ukraine who want a virtual Visa with Apple/Google Pay and no advertised FX mark-up
Users who prefer a card that claims not to take custody of their crypto
not_for: Anyone looking for a card without identity verification: ID documents and a liveness check are required
Residents of Austria, Hungary, the UK, the US, Singapore and the other territories prohibited by the Terms
Cash withdrawals (virtual card; ATM not mentioned) or cashback ('coming soon')
watch_outs: 'Zero fees' is explicitly 'for a limited time' with no published end date or fee schedule; the former 'Limits & Fees' page now redirects to the buy-crypto page.
The card page lists Austria and Hungary as available while the Terms of Use prohibit residents of both countries.
The card issuer is not named; the Terms attribute the card service to Chain Valley Sp. z o.o. in collaboration with Wirex Pay / Wirex Limited, and state Utorg is 'not attributed to banking services'.
Stablecoin-to-fiat conversion margin and top-up costs (beyond on-chain network fees) are not published — treated as unknown.
'Non-custodial' is the provider's own description and has not been verified.
